question: For weekly-sales data, I need an analysis of our sales performance around mid-June for the years 2018, 2019, and 2020. Specifically, calculate the percentage change in sales between the four weeks leading up to June 15 and the four weeks following June 15 for each year.
sql:
WITH pre_post AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_number IN (20, 21, 22, 23) THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as pre_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_number IN (25, 26, 27, 28) THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as post_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year IN (2018, 2019)
    GROUP BY calendar_year
),
pre_post_2020 AS (
    SELECT 
        2020 as calendar_year,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_number IN (21, 22, 23, 24) THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as pre_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_number IN (26, 27, 28, 29) THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as post_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020
    GROUP BY calendar_year
)
SELECT calendar_year, pre_sales, post_sales, ROUND((post_sales - pre_sales) * 1.0 / pre_sales * 100, 2) as pct_change
FROM pre_post
UNION ALL
SELECT calendar_year, pre_sales, post_sales, ROUND((post_sales - pre_sales) * 1.0 / pre_sales * 100, 2) as pct_change
FROM pre_post_2020
ORDER BY calendar_year
